title: Toy car crashes into dominoes

items.name: Steep ramp
items.why: A steep ramp of about 30°, from 45 cm up down to the table. Its length (about 0.9 m) follows from its two ends.

items.name: Toy car
items.why: Waits near the top of the ramp, sitting flat on its slope, until the release.

items.name: Long row of dominoes
items.why: Thirty standard 5 cm dominoes, all the same size, spaced 3 cm apart. The row is about 0.9 m long.

items.name: Safety wall
items.why: An unseen stop at the table's right end, so the car does not roll off.

notes: The car leaves the 45 cm ramp at roughly 2.5 m/s and rolls 40 cm along the table. Its 7 cm tall nose then hits the first domino, and the wave runs left to right down the whole 30-domino row in about a second. The car may plough a little way into the row as it falls.
assumptions: 'Steep' is taken as about 30°. Steeper ramps risk the car nosing into the table at the bottom.
The dominoes are standard 5 cm ones of equal size.
A 'long row' is taken as 30 dominoes, the most one row allows.
The car starts at rest near the top of the ramp and is released at 0.5 s.
